Chapter 836: Chapter 30: The Incredible Strongest Beings (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 836: Chapter 30: The Incredible Strongest Beings (Please Subscribe)

Refining the strongest weapon is naturally a task for the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

Lin Yuan’s true self shares with the two major Primordial Spirits’ wills; no matter which one refines it, the other two can enjoy the benefits.

Essentially, the true self and the Primordial Spirit belong to the same person.

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sits cross-legged.

“In a few more months, I can step into the eleventh layer.”

...

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Now, he has reached the extreme in almost every aspect.

The only choice left is to step into the eleventh layer.

In fact, with Lin Yuan’s current accumulation, let alone at the tenth layer, even within the eleventh layer, it is unprecedented.

To this day in this universe, no eleventh-layer being has ever comprehended the Sixth Realm of Space-Time.

“But now, maybe I could try becoming a ranked disciple of the Magic Jade Tower?”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred.

The disciples, or rather, the members of the Magic Jade Tower, are divided into four types:

Ordinary Disciple/Member.

Core Disciple/Member.

Ranked Disciple/Member.

Direct Disciple/Member.

According to Lin Yuan’s current choice to join Magic Jade Tower, the first condition to become a ranked disciple is to thoroughly comprehend all the demonic evolutionary paths within that strongest body.

The second condition is to be a being below the twelfth layer.

To become an ordinary disciple of the Magic Jade Tower, one needs to comprehend 3,333 demonic evolutionary paths.

To become a core disciple of the Magic Jade Tower, one needs to comprehend 33,333 demonic evolutionary paths.

And to become a ranked disciple, one must comprehend all the demonic evolutionary paths.

That is the condition for Lin Yuan to become a ranked disciple.

The ranked disciples of the Magic Jade Tower are already considered the elite foundation of the Magic Jade Tower; according to the suggestion of Statue Shen Ji, if Lin Yuan could become a ranked disciple, he would be authorized to take over that Demon Jade Space.

But becoming a ranked disciple is too difficult; even Shen Ji, who has witnessed many miracles, doesn’t believe Lin Yuan has a chance.

Comprehending all the demonic evolutionary paths? And restricted to beings below the twelfth layer?

Beings below the twelfth layer wanting to comprehend the demonic evolutionary paths from within the body of the strongest being? Even though this strongest being has fallen, it’s almost impossible to achieve.

When Magic Jade Tower was at its peak, most beings that became ranked disciples chose to cultivate a particular demonic evolutionary path and perfect it.

As for the few that comprehended the demonic evolutionary paths wholly? They also relied on the heritage keystones in Magic Jade Tower that specifically carried the demonic evolutionary paths for enlightenment.

Directly comprehending the demonic evolutionary paths from the body of the strongest being? Nearly impossible.

The interference from the body of the strongest being itself is too great, and the omnipresent will pressure greatly increases the difficulty of comprehending the demonic evolutionary paths.

But now Lin Yuan is considering giving it a try.

Primarily because the rewards of becoming a ranked disciple of Magic Jade Tower are quite tempting to Lin Yuan.

And taking over the Demon Jade Space would allow Lin Yuan to enjoy the benefits of being a ranked disciple to the greatest extent.

The last is the confidence Lin Yuan gained from the tenth traverse to comprehend all the demonic evolutionary paths.

…

Virtual World.

Space for contemplating the demonic evolutionary paths.

The phantom of that strongest body still floats above the sky.

Countless evolvers from human civilization have come and gone, gone and come.

Up until now, among the many evolvers of human civilization who have cultivated and supplemented demonic evolutionary paths to become ordinary members of Magic Jade Tower, there is only an evolver named ‘Yuan Qing.’

“The more one cultivates, the more one can feel the unfathomable depth of the strongest being’s level.”

Lin Yuan sits cross-legged on the mountain peak, looking up at that body.

Even though Lin Yuan has already reached the twelfth layer in certain aspects, there is still a vast gap compared to a true strongest being.

Not to mention anything else, but the universe inside the strongest being, which spans tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of light-years; how vast must the flesh and soul birthed in such a colossal internal universe be?

Lin Yuan’s internal world has already broken the restrictions and shackles of the Main Universe, yet it only spans two to three hundred million miles in radius; compared to the internal universe of the strongest being measured in light years, it’s not on the same level at all.

“Let’s start by comprehending the demonic evolutionary paths.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged, and he carefully observed the body above the sky.

Before performing the tenth traverse, the greatest obstacle Lin Yuan faced in contemplating this body was the omnipresent mental will pressure originating from within the body.

This mental will pressure constantly interfered with Lin Yuan’s contemplation of the demonic evolutionary paths.

Most crucially, compared to when the mental will index was below 100,000, this mental will pressure could still polish one’s own mental will.

Once the mental will index surpasses 100,000, the polishing effect of this mental will pressure is almost nonexistent.

Having lost the use of polishing the mental will and constantly disturbed by the mental will pressure, even Lin Yuan, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, doesn’t see a hope of comprehending all the demonic evolutionary paths in a short time.

The mental will pressure originates from the strongest beings, and all lifeforms beneath the strongest beings experience disturbances. The more evolution pathways of demons one comprehends, the greater the disturbance received.

But now?

The reason Lin Yuan has the confidence to fully comprehend all demonic evolution pathways is that he is confident in resisting this mental will pressure interference.

The tenth traversal brought Lin Yuan the greatest help, which was not achieving the Sixth Realm of space and time, but raising his mental will index to thirty-three million three hundred thirty-four thousand.

Achieving the Sixth Realm of space and time would have been possible for Lin Yuan even outside the Boundless Void, but such an immense increase in mental will? Lin Yuan had never anticipated that before traversing.

A mental will index of thirty to forty million not only reaches the level of the strongest, but also isn’t low among them. Facing the mental will pressure emanating from the bodies of strongest beings of the same level, it is not to say he can completely ignore it but resisting it wouldn’t take much effort.

As long as the interference from this mental will pressure is lost, with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, fully comprehending all demonic evolution pathways is just a matter of time.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding observed the mysterious body, comprehending ten kinds of demonic evolution pathways…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding observed the mysterious body, comprehending fifty kinds of demonic evolution pathways…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding observed the mysterious body, comprehending two hundred kinds of demonic evolution pathways…]

…

As Lin Yuan predicted, during this comprehension of the body, the mental will pressure that previously caused him great disturbance now feels like a spring breeze, no longer affecting him at all.

In just half a day, Lin Yuan had comprehended thousands of demonic evolution pathways.

“To fully comprehend all demonic evolution pathways, relying solely on the body projections in the Virtual World might not be sufficient, at the necessary moment, I need to comprehend the body itself.”

While Lin Yuan was comprehending, he still had the capacity to think about reliance.

The bodies that all human evolvers are comprehending are those where several strongest beings of human civilization jointly replicated part of that body’s essence and then projected it into the Virtual World.

As for why not to comprehend the body itself… it’s because the influence and contamination from the body itself are too great, even eleventh-tier evolvers dare not come too close, let alone comprehend.

As for evolvers below the eleventh-tier, if they dare to directly comprehend the body of the strongest, they would probably be burst by the immense information contained within the body of the strongest in an instant.

Even if not burst, they would quickly collapse under the massive mental will pressure originating from the body of the strongest itself.

But for Lin Yuan now, the aforementioned problems are no longer issues.

With Lin Yuan’s current mental will index, even if facing a living strongest being, he would stand fearless in terms of mental will, let alone a deceased strongest being.

That segment of the strongest being’s body must be kept in the Human Civilization Treasury.

Given Lin Yuan’s current status in human civilization, if he wants to directly comprehend that segment of the body, he just needs to mention it to Xia Qin and other strongest beings.

After all, it’s just comprehending, not taking away that body segment.

…

Lin Yuan divided a sliver of mental will to comprehend the numerous demonic evolution pathways within the body.

Meanwhile, his true self still sat on the Milky Way Main Star, adjusting his state to perfection as much as possible.

“Before stepping into the eleventh layer, I still need to meet a strongest being.”

Lin Yuan thought, remembering the terrifying disturbance caused by the Chaos Void Origin Infusion when he stepped into the tenth layer.

Now stepping into the eleventh layer, the disturbance would only be greater, so Lin Yuan naturally wanted to inform the strongest beings beforehand.

Provoking the Chaos Void Origin Infusion couldn’t be concealed; rather than having the strongest beings notice it during his breakthrough, it’s better to openly mention it now.

At least it would prepare several of the strongest beings of human civilization, so they needn’t worry about movements from other races.

As for the strongest beings of human civilization, Lin Yuan believed he could trust them, as long as he was a human evolver, he would receive support.

Buzz.

Thinking this, Lin Yuan again split off a sliver of will, entering the Virtual World.

…

Xia You Virtual World.

Xia Qin, the strongest being, sat on the throne and suddenly opened his eyes.

“Galaxy Master is looking for me?” Xia Qin’s expression grew slightly solemn: “Is it about discussing advancing to the eleventh tier?”

Since knowing that Lin Yuan had comprehended the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at the tenth layer, he had no doubts about Lin Yuan advancing to the eleventh tier.

The Pillar-level Fusion Rules Second Realm allows entry to the eleventh tier, and comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule also enables entry to the eleventh tier.

In terms of difficulty, the latter is many times harder than the former.

“In this era of human civilization, a genius of this caliber is born…”

Xia Qin felt quite emotional after agreeing to Lin Yuan’s entry.

The tenth layer comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule? Xia Qin had only heard a few pieces of information about such monstrous entities from inheritances outside the universe.

As for within the universe? At least Xia Qin, the Galaxy Master, had never known of such unparalleled geniuses being born.

After not much time.

Xia Qin saw Lin Yuan’s figure appear.

Since it was within the Virtual World, whether it be Xia Qin or Lin Yuan, both were condensed from a sliver of mental will.

“Galaxy Master…”

Xia Qin smiled and was about to ask Lin Yuan what was the matter.

But the next moment, Xia Qin could not smile anymore.

He looked at Lin Yuan somewhat incredulously, sizing him up repeatedly, almost doubting his own senses.
